name: Galactic Event
endDateNote: End date cited by third-party event guides; Roblox official page and virtual-events API did not list an event entry in the May 26 check.
description: Limited-time galactic-themed event reported live by public event guides, with Void Shards currency, Galactic Zombies, Galactic Crates, and Atlantis map coverage. Roblox official page/API confirms the game updated on 2026-05-26 but does not name Galactic or Atlantis.

voidShards.name: Void Shards
voidShards.role: Primary event currency for Galactic Crates
voidShards.dropSource: Galactic Zombies (purple zombies with glowing orbs above their heads)

spawnRate.note: IGN reports a 1% Galactic Zombie appearance chance; stronger Galactic Zombies may have better Void Shard drop chances. Not confirmed in official Roblox page text.

voidShards.collection: Manual pickup — shards do not auto-collect per community guides.
voidShards.crateCostNote: At least 50 Void Shards required to open one Galactic Crate from the lobby crate station (IGN/media-reported).

economyPoll.question: Default Credits vs new event currency for Galactic Crates

relatedCode.note: Some guides claim a GALACTIC code for Credits while others claim a Void Shards boost; Discord #codes has no post from the prior audit, and Roblox page text did not mention the code — see codes.json.

atlantisMap.name: Atlantis Map
atlantisMap.note: IGN reports Atlantis is available to all players during the Galactic Event. Roblox official page text did not name Atlantis in the May 26 check; route and layout details still need in-game confirmation.
